title: PropertyInstanceEnvelope.v1
description: Evaluator-only identity and assignment envelope for one exhaustive property instance.
$comment: This envelope cannot contain expected, oracle output, runner_input, or materialized fixture bytes and is never projected directly to the SUT. The owning PropertySuite freezes the exact domain, domain order, instance_id algorithm, case_id algorithm, materializer, and validation policy. instance_id is a content ID over {suite_id, assignment}; case_id is a stable non-content identifier derived from suite_id and the one-based ordinal. envelope_sha256 is SHA-256 over the UTF-8 RFC 8785 JCS bytes of this object with envelope_sha256 omitted.
